key.name: screencast-save-directory
key.summary: Screen recording destination directory
key.description: Empty uses Videos/Screencasts, or Home/Screencasts when Videos is undefined. Otherwise use an absolute directory or ~/ path.

key.name: screenshot-save-directory
key.summary: Screenshot destination directory
key.description: Empty uses Pictures/Screenshots, or Home/Screenshots when Pictures is undefined. Otherwise use an absolute directory or ~/ path.

key.name: screenshot-copy-to-clipboard
key.summary: Also copy captured PNG images to the clipboard

key.name: bluetooth-settings-command
key.summary: Command used to open Bluetooth settings
key.description: Executable and optional quoted arguments for the Bluetooth manager. Shell expansion is not performed. Changes take effect on the next click.

key.name: suspend-method
key.summary: The suspend method used when suspend is invoked from Quick Settings
key.description: The method used to suspend the system. Options are: suspend, hybrid_sleep, suspend_then_hibernate, hibernate, If the provided suspend method is not available way-shell will walk the list above and pick the first supported suspention method.

key.name: backlight-directory
key.summary: The relative directory of your backlight device file
key.description: The directory located under /sys/class/backlight/ which contains the backlight device files such as "brightness" and "max_brightness" The default is 'intel_backlight' but this may need to change depending on your machine.

key.name: keyboard-backlight-directory
key.summary: The relative directory of your backlight device file
key.description: The directory located typically under /sys/class/leds/ which contains the keyboard backlight device files such as "brightness" and "max_brightness" There is no default since this tends to be specific to the manufacturer. For instance Lenovo Thinkpads usually have they keyboard backlight directory idenified as '/sys/class/leds/tpacpi::kbd_backlight'

key.name: idle-inhibitor
key.summary: Enable the idle inhibitor
key.description: Enable or disable the idle inhibitor. When enabled the system will not suspend or hibernate when the screen is locked. The inhibitor lock is created via LoginD and way-shell expects the idle daemon to integrate with this service as well to understand ide locks.

key.name: light-theme
key.summary: Enable the light theme
key.description: When enabled way-shell will switch to the its light them. While disabled the dark theme is shown. When the theme is changed way-shell will execute a bash script at ~/.config/way-shell/on_theme_changed.sh will be invoked with the argument "dark" or "light" depending on which theme was picked.

key.name: sway-config-path
key.summary: Optional absolute or ~/ Sway configuration path for shortcuts

key.name: niri-config-path
key.summary: Optional absolute or ~/ Niri configuration path for shortcuts

key.name: backend
key.summary: The window manager backend to use (default: sway)
key.description:
Instructs Way-Shell which window manager to use. Currently supported options are "sway" and "niri".
Changing this setting requires a restart to take effect.

key.name: sort-workspaces-alphabetical
key.summary: Sort workpaces alphabetically
key.description: Enabling this option will sort workspaces alphabetically. If its disabled workspaces are not sorted and are displayed in creation order.

key.name: ignored-toplevels-app-ids
key.summary: A colon separated list of app-ids to ignore.
key.description:
Way-Shell will ignore any Wayland toplevel with an app-id field matching any string in this list. Way-Shell will not be informed about the creation or closing of these toplevels. The app-id should be the string provided by the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 Wayland object.
Request restart to take effect.

key.name: ignored-toplevels-titles
key.summary: A colon separated list of title to ignore.
key.description:
Way-Shell will ignore any Wayland toplevel with a title field matching any string in this list. Way-Shell will not be informed about the creation or closing of these toplevels. The title should be the string provided by the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 Wayland object.
By default any window with a permanent title of "scratchpad" is ignored.
Request restart to take effect.

key.name: focus-urgent-workspace
key.summary: Whether to focus workspaces that are set to urgent
key.description:
Way-Shell will automatically focus workspaces which become urgent when this configuration is set to true.
Workspaces are marked urgent when an application requests to be focused. This typically occurs when the app first opens and when the app requests focus.
In practice, enabling this setting provides a more traditional feel when launching apps or clicking notifications, as Way-Shell informs the window manager to focus the app generating these events.

key.name: do-not-disturb
key.summary: DoNotDisturb

key.name: clock-format
key.summary: The format to display the current time in on the panel.
key.description: This is passed as the `format` argument to g_date_time_format when rendering the clock in the panel. Note that the clock only ticks every minute, so precise specifiers such as %S are useless. Way-Shell must be restarted for changes to take effect.

key.name: enable-tray-icons
key.summary: Whether tray icons and their menus should be displayed
key.description:
Way-Shell can display tray icons for applications which present them.
This is an experimental feature which may cause some issues. Therefore, if issues are encountered you can disable them with this flag.
Way-Shell must be restarted for changes to take effect.
